title: Coral and the Clock
author: Vesper Vasquez
blurb: Wendell Vasquez, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
